x402-dotnet-client.source: michielpost/x402-dotnet@127c1fd (read only, never run; src/x402.Client.Nano unchanged at 4375ecc), NuGet x402.Client.Nano 0.0.3. Quote read only from the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, base64 JSON, kept only when x402Version == 2, no body fallback (src/x402.Client/v2/PaymentRequiredV2Handler.cs:116-138). PaymentRequiredResponse.Resource is `required` (src/x402.Core/Models/v2/PaymentRequiredResponse.cs:13), so a header without `resource` fails to deserialize and is dropped (net11.0 System.Text.Json). Accept checks in NanoWallet.Check (src/x402.Client.Nano/NanoWallet.cs:138-160): scheme exact, network == wallet network (default nano:mainnet, NanoNetworks.cs:9), asset XNO case-insensitive, payTo nano_/xrb_ format, Amount digits > 0; `Amount` is a required member (PaymentRequirements.cs:25), so maxAmountRequired alone is not read. Cap: NanoAllowance set by the host (NanoWallet.cs:162-173); no allowance set pays nothing. `extra` is never read.

x402-mcp-wrapper+x402nano-exact-1.1.0.source: B19, lane 3 (FRONTIER row 75), confirmed by the PR agent from the npm tarballs (npm pack, read only, nothing run): @x402/mcp 2.32.0 wrapMCPClientWithPayment(mcpClient, x402Client) (dist/esm/index.mjs:777-779) with @x402/core 2.32.0 x402Client and @x402nano/exact 1.1.0 ExactNanoScheme registered by register("nano:mainnet", ...) (core dist/esm/client/index.mjs:106-108: the current x402Version, 2, only). The offer is read only from an MCP tool result with isError true: structuredContent, else JSON in content[0].text (mcp index.mjs:714-742), validated by @x402/core parsePaymentRequired (mcp index.mjs:753-756; core dist/esm/chunk-Z7WXFCST.mjs:56-62: v2 needs `resource` {url} and accepts with `amount`); an HTTP header or body is never read. A v1 offer parses but createPaymentPayload throws `No client registered for x402 version: 1` (core client/index.mjs:254-256). selectPaymentRequirements (:437-493): network/scheme registered (:442-448), a non-empty asset (:467-474), then applySpendControls (:503-527): ExactNanoScheme has no findDefaultAsset, so with the default spendControls {} (:69) every Nano accept is refused (:523-527) unless spendControls.allowedAssets has an entry matching network (glob, core chunk-XW2CWVLZ.mjs:66) and asset (:25-37), or allowedAssets is true, or spendControls is false; an entry's maxAmountPerPayment is an atomic cap (:39-51, :554-575). No other cap (no default asset, so no USD cap). ExactNanoScheme.createPaymentPayload needs payTo and amount (exact dist/cjs/client/index.js:61-66) and reads `paymentRequirements?.extra.workOptional` (dist/cjs/client/index.js:67), a TypeError when the accept has no `extra`. The payment goes back as the PaymentPayload object in params._meta["x402/payment"] (mcp index.mjs:509, :540-542, MCP_PAYMENT_META_KEY :98).

buyer_plan.source: OURS: the buyer_plan planner, plan.py (package xno-buyer-plan 0.1.0; not part of this registry repository and not on PyPI; this row is judged by client_fit.py's own rules, which never import it), the 7th row (expert GUIDE 2026-11-22T12:50Z). It plans, it does not sign or send: `yes` means plan_402 or plan_mcp returns a plan. plan_402 reads the PAYMENT-REQUIRED or X-PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, else the body (client_fit.parse_402); plan_mcp reads an MCP isError result's structuredContent, else content[0].text. Accepts: scheme exact (plan_402 loop), network in NETWORKS {nano:mainnet, nano-mainnet}, plus `nano` for a bound accept only (BOUND_NETWORKS; x402-gateway src/x402.js:126 names its XNO entry `nano`); payTo checksum; amount == maxAmountRequired, ASCII digits > 0; no version, resource, asset or extra required. Cap: cap_raw is a required argument the caller sets (DEFAULT_CAP_RAW 10^29 when it passes none), so as for x402-dotnet the cap is the host's own: only a positive integer amount is checked here. Bindings: xno-binding/v1/rep (_plan_bound); any other binding is refused by name. Send-hash and invoice quotes are planned from their flat terms (_plan_flat; client_fit.flat_fit). The MCP profile defaults to `spec`, so xmcp's v1 network `nano` (unbound) is no:network unless the caller names profile xmcp.
